arguments.content: import requests, re, json, os, time, sys from collections import defaultdict, deque from urllib.parse import quote HEADERS = { "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0.0.0 Safari/537.36", "Accept": "text/html,application/xhtml+xml,application/xml;q=0.9,*/*;q=0.8", "Accept-Language": "en-US,en;q=0.5", } def fetch_scholar_page(user_id): url = f"https://scholar.google.com/citations?user={user_id}&hl=en" try: r = requests.get(url, headers=HEADERS, timeout=30) if r.status_code != 200: return None return r.text except Exception as e: print(f"Error fetching {user_id}: {e}") return None def extract_name(html): m = re.search(r'\s*‪([^‪]+)‬\s*-\s*Google Scholar', html) if m: return m.group(1).strip() m = re.search(r'<div[^>]*class="[^"]*gsc_prf_in[^"]*"[^>]*>([^<]+)</div>', html) if m: return m.group(1).strip() return None def extract_coauthors_from_html(html): """Extract co-authors from the profile page.""" coauthors = set() # Look for co-author links pattern = r'href="/citations\?user=([^"]+)"[^>]*>([^<]+)</a>' matches = re.findall(pattern, html) for user_id, name in matches: if user_id and name and len(name) > 1: coauthors.add((user_id.strip(), name.strip())) return coauthors def extract_paper_coauthors(html): """Extract co-authors from paper listings on the page.""" coauthors = set() # Pattern for paper author lists # Look for author names in the paper listings author_pattern = r'<div[^>]*class="[^"]*gsc_a_t[^"]*"[^>]*>.*?<div[^>]*class="gs_gray"[^>]*>([^<]+)</div>' matches = re.findall(author_pattern, html, re.DOTALL) for match in matches: authors = match.split(',') for author in authors: author = author.strip() if author and len(author) > 1: # We don't have the user ID here, just the name pass return coauthors def get_scholar_profile(user_id, cache_dir="/tmp_workspace/scholar_cache"): os.makedirs(cache_dir, exist_ok=True) cache_file = os.path.join(cache_dir, f"{user_id}.json") if os.path.exists(cache_file): with open(cache_file, 'r') as f: return json.load(f) html = fetch_scholar_page(user_id) if not html: return None name = extract_name(html) coauthors = extract_coauthors_from_html(html) profile = { "user_id": user_id, "name": name, "coauthors": list(coauthors) } with open(cache_file, 'w') as f: json.dump(profile, f) time.sleep(2) # Be polite to Google return profile def bfs_scholar_connection(start_id, end_id, max_depth=4): """BFS to find shortest connection between two scholars.""" visited = set() queue = deque([(start_id, [start_id])]) while queue: current_id, path = queue.popleft() if len(path) > max_depth + 1: continue if current_id == end_id and len(path) > 1: return path if current_id in visited: continue visited.add(current_id) profile = get_scholar_profile(current_id) if not profile: continue print(f"Exploring {profile.get('name', current_id)} (depth {len(path)}), found {len(profile.get('coauthors', []))} coauthors") for coauthor_id, coauthor_name in profile.get('coauthors', []): if coauthor_id not in visited: new_path = path + [coauthor_id] if coauthor_id == end_id: return new_path queue.append((coauthor_id, new_path)) return None def main(): A_ID = "hUrX-LMAAAAJ" B_ID = "JicYPdAAAAAJ" print("Fetching scholar A profile...") a_profile = get_scholar_profile(A_ID) print(f"A: {a_profile.get('name', 'Unknown')}") print(f"Coauthors found: {len(a_profile.get('coauthors', []))}") print("\nFetching scholar B profile...") b_profile = get_scholar_profile(B_ID) print(f"B: {b_profile.get('name', 'Unknown')}") print("\nSearching for connection...") connection = bfs_scholar_connection(A_ID, B_ID, max_depth=4) if connection: print(f"\nConnection found! Path length: {len(connection) - 1}") print("Path:") for user_id in connection: profile = get_scholar_profile(user_id) print(f" - {profile.get('name', user_id)} ({user_id})") else: print("\nNo connection found within search depth.") # Save results os.makedirs("/tmp_workspace/results", exist_ok=True) with open("/tmp_workspace/results/results.md", 'w') as f: f.write("# Scholar Connection Results\n\n") f.write(f"## Scholar A\n- Name: {a_profile.get('name', 'Unknown')}\n") f.write(f"- Google Scholar ID: {A_ID}\n") f.write(f"- URL: https://scholar.google.com/citations?user={A_ID}\n\n") f.write(f"## Scholar B\n- Name: {b_profile.get('name', 'Unknown')}\n") f.write(f"- Google Scholar ID: {B_ID}\n") f.write(f"- URL: https://scholar.google.com/citations?user={B_ID}\n\n") if connection: f.write("## Connection Found\n\n") f.write(f"**Shortest path length:** {len(connection) - 1} collaboration(s)\n\n") f.write("**Path:**\n\n") for i, user_id in enumerate(connection): profile = get_scholar_profile(user_id) name = profile.get('name', user_id) f.write(f"{i+1}. **{name}** ({user_id})\n") if i < len(connection) - 1: f.write(f" ↓ collaborated with\n") f.write("\n") else: f.write("## Result\n\nNo connection found within the search depth.\n\n") f.write("## Co-authors of Scholar A\n\n") for coauthor_id, coauthor_name in a_profile.get('coauthors', [])[:20]: f.write(f"- {coauthor_name} ({coauthor_id})\n") print("\nResults saved to /tmp_workspace/results/results.md") if __name__ == "__main__": main()
